WBT.settings.apiBase.name: World Building Tome API base URL
WBT.settings.apiBase.hint: The HTTPS URL of your World Building Tome backend (e.g. https://api.worldbuildingtome.io). No trailing slash.
WBT.settings.connectionToken.name: Foundry connection token
WBT.settings.connectionToken.hint: Paste the token shown once when you created this Foundry connection in the app. If you lose it, revoke the connection and create a new one.
